answers.q6_description: RentQueue orders rental-assistance applicants. It is a vendor product in the vendor cloud. Staff are supposed to review the order. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: The unit wants a faster waitlist than a spreadsheet. The product sorts applicants. How staff use that sort is only partly written down. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: The sort can move an applicant up or down the rental-assistance waitlist.
answers.q20_harm: A wrong rank could delay housing help for a household. The household bears the cost. The office has not finished the review, notice, or contract controls.
